Remark
[Yano's theorem for affine vector fields]

Source: petersen:page-0345 ↗ rem:pet-ch8-ex-8-4-12 1. ch8:8.4.13If $X$ is an affine vector field, show that $\operatorname {tr}\nabla ^2X=-\mathrm{Ric}(X)$ and that $\operatorname {div}X$ is constant. Use this together with the characterizations of item 5 to show that on closed manifolds affine fields are Killing fields.
